kind: Observed static production graph and inventory API facts, not final trust/all-tool effect proof

facts.fact: Production child starts fixed server with config.project:false, private config directory, nativeSkillsConfig content, models.fetch:false; existing supervisor tracks runtime calls and owned exits.
Native config content selects fixed contained app-owned workbench-skills plugin with in-memory nonce; selected resource manifest validated before child imports.
Existing trusted plugin registers private RPC and setupNativeAgents/setupNativeExtensions; no new parallel runtime owner required for future private observation guard.

ToolDomain.list explicitly returns currently registered tools after every transform, with effective IDs and options plus live callbacks. Callbacks must never cross public DTO; metadata generation alone cannot prove callback purity.

Native internal plugin requirements include Session/Tool/Permission services; public promise plugin Context exposes SessionDomain. Prefer existing SDK session.wait over undocumented access to internal graph services.

open_trust_checks: Confirm private namespace config-file precedence cannot activate untrusted plugins; fixed content alone is not proof of all merge semantics.
Enumerate trusted builtin hooks and dynamic owned MCP definitions; reject incomplete/unexpected inventory before preset activation.
Read-only mutation-deny proof must cover direct/CodeMode, before-execute hooks, saved grants and current configured-deny semantics.
